messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. You have decided to move to your left. Tell Person 2 which side of them you will pass on, using their left or right: what do you say?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
On your left  
Because I move to my left (the corridor’s right as seen by Person 2 facing me), so I pass on Person 2’s left side.
